svg.title: ttt-large-chunk
svg.desc: Arithmetic intensity of a fast-weight matmul r = b / (1 + 2b/h) FLOP per byte versus chunk size b, for fast-weight width h = 64, 256 and 1024. TTT with b = 16, h = 64 reaches about 11, far below the H100 ridge of about 290; only large chunks with wide fast weights cross it. LaCT mask: tokens read W updated on earlier chunks and use sliding-window attention locally. Reported: GPU utilization below 5 % for small-batch TTT versus up to 70 % on A100 for LaCT; state per block 2304d versus 384d (GLA) and 128d (DeltaNet).

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: r = 2h2 b / (2h2 + 4hb) ≤ min(h/2, b) FLOP/B one update per b = 2K–1M tokens
LaCT language model: who reads what
3B, 32K, A100: train tok/s 4.3K (LaCT-Muon) vs 4.1K full attention
largest LaCT state: 12d² per block ≈ 40 % of weights
